name: lovable
description: Connect Lovable to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Lovable MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Lovable to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with build apps from prompts using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Lovable workspace.
Find anything in Lovable that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review build apps from prompts in Lovable.
